## What's Changed

- Added a compact Settings section menu so configuration areas are easier to reach.
- Reduced empty space in Settings so controls use the workspace more effectively.
- Made sidebar controls feel steadier while moving through history and footer actions.
- Improved image template cards so saved templates are easier to scan.
- Kept update banner actions aligned when progress or error details wrap.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/officecli/officedex/compare/v0.5.26...v0.5.27
